Settings.Row.KeepRunning.Description: 交给 PM2 托管：关掉启动器或酒馆窗口后，服务继续在后台运行。
Run through PM2 so the service keeps running after you close the launcher or the tavern window.
Settings.KeepRunning.Pm2Tip: 安装 PM2 后才能让酒馆在关闭启动器后继续运行。
Install PM2 to keep the tavern running after the launcher closes.
Dw.Closed.Stopping: 正在停止酒馆服务。想让它继续在后台运行，请打开「关闭启动器后继续运行」（需要 PM2）。
Stopping the tavern service. To keep it running, turn on "Keep running after the launcher closes" (requires PM2).
Dw.Closed.KeepingUnmanaged: 酒馆仍在运行。本次是直连启动，关闭启动器时会一并停止。
The tavern is still running. It was started directly, so it stops when you close the launcher.
